Solution: Finance Portal queued payments are sent to the bank integration nightly; delete and recreate the queued payment after the IBAN update; add a validation step that flags IBAN changes on vendors with pending payments.

knownIssues.title: E-Invoice (e-Fatura) received from vendor does not appear in the Finance Portal inbox
knownIssues.content: The GIB (Revenue Administration) e-Fatura API integration token has expired. Solution: renew the GIB API token from the e-Fatura portal and update it in Finance Portal > Admin > Integrations > GIB e-Fatura; the portal polls GIB every 15 minutes for new invoices once the token is valid.

knownIssues.title: Payment batch export to bank is rejected due to IBAN format validation failure
knownIssues.content: The IBAN stored for one or more vendors uses spaces or non-standard formatting. Solution: in Finance Portal > Vendor Master, standardize all IBAN entries by removing spaces and ensuring they follow the TR XX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX XX format; the portal's IBAN validator can flag non-conforming entries in bulk.

knownIssues.title: Finance Portal shows negative outstanding balance for a vendor
knownIssues.content: A credit note or debit memo was applied twice due to a duplicate import from the ERP integration. Solution: identify the duplicate in Finance Portal > Vendor Ledger and void one of the entries; add a uniqueness check on the document reference number in the ERP integration to prevent duplicate imports.

knownIssues.title: Monthly P&L report generation times out after 10 minutes
knownIssues.content: The P&L report query is joining multiple large tables without using indexed fiscal period columns. Solution: add composite indexes on (FISCAL_YEAR, FISCAL_PERIOD, COST_CENTER) to the financial transaction tables; in the Finance Portal admin, reduce the default report date range to the current quarter; schedule large reports as background jobs.

knownIssues.title: Exchange rate-adjusted figures in consolidated reports differ from manually calculated values
knownIssues.content: The portal is applying the month-end spot rate to all transactions, but the accounting policy requires the transaction-date rate for expense items. Solution: in Finance Portal > Reporting Settings > Currency, configure 'Use transaction-date rate for income statement items' and 'Use closing rate for balance sheet items'; validate with the finance team.

knownIssues.title: Report exported to Excel loses number formatting (Turkish decimal/thousand separators)
knownIssues.content: The Excel export uses the server locale (English) instead of the user's locale. Solution: in Finance Portal > User Preferences, set the number format locale to 'Turkish (Turkey)'; in the export settings, ensure 'Apply user locale to exports' is enabled; alternatively, use the Finance Portal's CSV export with locale formatting.

knownIssues.title: Department heads cannot see cross-department comparison reports
knownIssues.content: The role permission for 'Cross-department view' is not enabled for the Department Head role. Solution: in Finance Portal > Role Management, edit the Department Head role and enable 'View > Cross-department reports'; assign this role to department heads who require the comparison view.

knownIssues.title: New finance team member cannot log in to Finance Portal
knownIssues.content: The user's account was created in AD but has not been provisioned in Finance Portal. Solution: in Finance Portal Admin > Users > Sync from AD, run a manual sync or wait for the nightly AD sync job; if the user is needed immediately, create the account manually and link it to their AD account.

knownIssues.title: User can view all departments' budgets despite being assigned a department-scoped role
knownIssues.content: The user has been added to the 'Global Finance' AD group in addition to their department group, and the 'Global Finance' group has an elevated Finance Portal role. Solution: review the user's AD group memberships and remove them from any groups that grant unintended access; audit Finance Portal roles assigned to AD groups regularly.

knownIssues.title: Approval delegation is routing to the wrong backup approver
knownIssues.content: Two delegation rules are active for the same approver, and the portal is applying the older rule instead of the newer one. Solution: in Finance Portal > Delegation Management, check for overlapping delegation rules for the approver; deactivate the outdated rule and verify the correct backup approver is now assigned.

knownIssues.title: Finance Portal session expires mid-entry causing data loss
knownIssues.content: The session timeout is set to 15 minutes, which is too short for complex invoice entry workflows. Solution: in Finance Portal Admin > Security > Session Settings, increase the session timeout to 60 minutes for users with Finance roles; enable 'Auto-save draft' for invoice entry forms to preserve in-progress work.
